query: What do Motorola Moto G Power (2022) owners report about camera quality, including blurry shots or photos in low light?
search_text: What do ) owners report about camera quality, including blurry shots or photos in low light?

rows.text: Camera in low light..not the best... Upgrading from my 2nd MOTO G7 Power. A much older phone, and yet, the camera quality manages to beat every other Moto I get, regardless of the price. The lowlight for Moto G7 Power is great, natural light. This MOTO G Power is a blurry mess. And since it wants to take multiple pictures at once, it's so slow just to take one simple picture. At least MOTO didn't put the headphone jack on the bottom on the 2021 model, unlike the 2020 model. They seem to switch it every other year just to annoy users. All in all, my Moto G7 Power 32gb out performs this MOTO Power 2021, which is infuriating.

Good phone - bad camera. Considering this phone's price, I really can't complain! However, if you're looking for a phone with a decent camera and good photos, stay away from this phone. Most of the time pictures are blurry and look horrible when you zoom in.

Worst camera ever! I don't know what good the extra cameras are doing, just seems to make it even slower to load and if you STILL have a shot when it finally does turn on then you're dealing with it constantly focusing and asking you to switch to " night vision" or " macro" and then I end up with lots of blurry shots anyway face with rolling eyes No doubt I need to spend even MORE time with the tutorials, but who the heck has time for that? Or the sh-I've a g-it to WANT to learn how to take the perfect shot? It's 2022 and I want to point and click already. tired face

Battery is great as long as you keep display dim. Better photo's than ratings claimed!. Battery is great as long as you keep display dim. Better photo's than ratings claimed! Ended up with some spectacular shots in St. Croix!

No joke! I took a lot of side by side shots with my old phone in the same lighting and distance and the only thing that I can say that was an improvement is the outdoor, front facing color saturation and balance. Most of the photos are very pixelated. When zoomed they almost look like there is a screen in front of them. The selfie camera is really washed out and overcompensated even with the photo compensation off. Same goes for the front even when used outside. It almost looks like a painting filter or playdough. I thought something was on the lens but that's not the case. As for macro- it's great! It picked up all the droplets in my steamy french press beautifully and with a flash it became a lovely bokeh. Photos taken 6 ft no zoom do not have good clarity or detail.

Not that great. It seems to drop calls and have extremely slow internet compared to my Samsung S7... even my S5. The camera quality is NOT 46MP. Very blurry with any sort of zoom. The battery is good, but that is about it. Maybe I received a lemon?

Mediocre. I've been using Moto G phones for years because they're affordable and the camera quality has been decent. I was hoping that with current technology, the camera would be great. It's... Okay. The quality is just okay. But what's most frustrating is the camera app itself has a HUGE lag in processing time, so I'm constantly missing good shots and I'm left with a blur because of a 10+ second delay in the photo being taken! It takes forever to exit/close the camera app as well. Motorola is useless in response to reviews on the camera app, too, just asking for screenshots of the issue. HOW? I also have lots of issues with the screen responding to touch if I'm not holding it normally. For example, if I have the phone laying on a table and I'm trying to tap or type, it just won't work.

Finally I'm underwhelmed by the macro lens camera, which I had been looking forward to. It takes a much smaller (in terms of megapixels) photo which has obvious artifacts at low magnification. It's also very unsaturated compared to the standard camera. I've pretty much quit using it as it doesn't improve on what you can shoot with the regular camera. No complaints about performance or speed. My games and apps load quickly and I can run more of them simultaneously. It's really a perfectly fine phone at a reasonable price. Just some of the upgrades are underwhelming.
camera is lagging badly. camera lag when you have many photos videos makes this phone inoperable
Awful camera. The phone itself is good, 4 stars, but image quality from the camera is definitely 2 stars. It's terrible. I wish I had purchased the Nord instead

Affordable quality. I purchased two of these phones,. One for my niece. & one for her mom, my sister. My niece goes digital art & simple video edits, and texts and group chats A LOT. My sister plays COD on her phone and makes shameless use of filters. She’s a big texter/caller too. She loves DLC. The camera is excellent! The phone has good sound quality for talking. You’re not going to light up the party with it but it’s good for close by music lists or tiktok scrolling.

Decent. As an owner of Moto phones for many years, I really like this phone, the long battery life, and the forward facing camera is excellent, but the 'selfie' camera is not impressive and most selfies are kind of blurry.

Worst camera of any I've ever owned.. People actually tell me to not even bother sending them photos cause they are so pixalted. I like the phone other than.thay I thought with 4 camera lenses it would be great but my htc one M8 from like 10 years ago makes this camera look like my first Fuji 2mp camera from the year 2000.

Camera what they claim. This phone was pretty it was sleek, and the battery seemed great, but the camera definitely is not at all what they say it lags quite a bit in lax, some basic features of phones older than this one even as a budget phone the camera quality that they claimed should’ve been what they said and it’s not other than that the phone seems decent

Returned very quickly. Received this phone and returned it the same day. Battery drained 60% during setup, however on another phone I received since, only 20% drained during setup. Screen seemed somewhat dim and fuzzy, camera is truly horrible. Do not buy this phone if you remotely care about the camera and quality photos as extra pixels in the description does not necessarily mean better quality cameras. I quickly did every type of troubleshooting I could find on Google in case I was missing something before giving up on the phone itself. I don't know if I got a bad phone or something, it was supposedly new. Big disappointment.

Two years later..... After almost two years with the 2021 G Power, I would not recommend it. I bought it for what was supposed to be a good value, its ability to increase storage with micro SD and its reported battery life. Currently, the battery, which is bigger and heavier than most phones, has degraded to the point that I have to charge it almost daily (and I am a moderate to low user). Bluetooth sucks. I have to toggle the bluetooth on and off each time I get in my car, or I have no connection. Forget my bluetooth speaker at home, as I cannot connect with it at all, while all other devices have no problem. Camera is worthless for anything other than spurring memories, as shots are focused only when you keep the photo camera-sized. Message sometimes notifies me, sometimes not.

Bad Camera. I though I was going to get a decent affordable phone. The camera takes very grainy photos. I've checked settings, camera settings, and looked up online how to fix it because this phone has three camera lenses. But nope. Come to find out the best camera settings for this phone is 12MP. If you want crisp clear and colorful pictures look for something with 64MP. Here's the stinger, my husband's old Motorola takes better pictures that this brand new 2022 version. My 5-6 year old Samsung with one camera lense took better pictures. This phone also runs pretty slow too. It runs all my apps slowly and have had to completely exit out and refresh so it could work again. Battery life is excellent. It lasts 3 days if you don't use it, but it does last all day with regular use.

AVOID the 2021 version - Moto cheaped out and decreased the specs!. Buy a 2020 version all the way. The 2021 model "increased" rear photo, but it decreased the front camera. Most importantly, Moto decreased screen resolution from 1080P to 720P. Don't think it matters? IT DOES! Blurry images and a general "cheap" feel with a plastic case (2020 was aluminum). The 2020 also has full 4K video recording... and yet Moto took that away too in 2021. Feeling ripped off yet buying a 2021 version? In order to get the 2020 Power features, you need to buy the $350 5G model. Moto's Marketing at its finest at the expense of the consumer.

Failed after 4 months. It glitches way to much to be a new(ish) phone, after 4 months of purchased. The camera is grainy in low light and the battery lasts about a day. Would not recommend. Going back to Samsung.

OK Phone Overall, But Do Not Buy If You Want a Decent Camera!. Phone works pretty well overall. Battery life is impressive. However, camera quality is so-so and it is fussy trying to wake it up. How it is getting nearly five stars is beyond me, so I would be very suspect of the opinions of others, at least on Amazon.
